topic: sub:11|Time and location|Time and time differences

parts.latex:
Sydney is 10 hours ahead of Coordinated Universal Time (UTC $+10$) and New York is 5 hours behind Coordinated Universal Time (UTC $-5$).

Tony travels from Sydney to New York. His plane leaves Sydney at 8:20 pm on Wednesday local time and flies non-stop to New York.

The flight takes 20 hours and 24 minutes.

What time and day is it in New York when the plane lands?

solutions.latex:
Sydney is ahead of New York by
$$10 - (-5) = 15 \text{ hours}$$
Add the flight time to the departure time (Sydney time):
$$8{:}20 \text{ pm Wednesday} + 20\text{ h }24\text{ min} = 4{:}44 \text{ pm Thursday}$$
Subtract the time difference to get New York time:
$$4{:}44 \text{ pm} - 15 \text{ hours} = 1{:}44 \text{ am}$$
$$\therefore\ \text{it is } 1{:}44 \text{ am Thursday in New York}$$
criteria: Finds the time in Sydney when the plane lands in New York, or equivalent merit
Finds the time difference between Sydney and New York, or equivalent merit

parts.latex:
Sakura will travel from Sydney (UTC $+10$) to Rio de Janeiro (UTC $-3$).

The flight from Sydney to Rio de Janeiro will take 20 hours.

The flight will arrive in Rio de Janeiro at 3 pm on Wednesday 20 July.

On what day and at what time will Sakura leave Sydney?

solutions.latex:
Sydney is 13 hours ahead of Rio (UTC $+10$ and UTC $-3$).

Rio arrival time minus flight time:

$$3\text{ pm}-20\text{ hours}=7\text{ pm Tuesday 19 July (Rio time)}$$

Add the time difference of 13 hours:

$$7\text{ pm}+13\text{ hours}=8\text{ am Wednesday 20 July}$$

Alternative method: convert the arrival to Sydney time first.

$$3\text{ pm}+13\text{ hours}=4\text{ am Thursday 21 July}$$

$$4\text{ am}-20\text{ hours}=8\text{ am Wednesday 20 July}$$

Sakura leaves Sydney at 8 am on Wednesday 20 July.
criteria: Provides 7 pm Tuesday or 4 am Thursday, or equivalent merit

parts.latex:
The Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) of Auckland is $+12$ hours and the UTC of Chicago is $-5$ hours.

When the time in Chicago is 2 pm, Thursday, what is the time in Auckland?

solutions.latex:
The time difference is the difference between the UTC offsets.
$$12 - (-5) = 17 \text{ hours}$$
Auckland is 17 hours ahead of Chicago.

Add 17 hours to 2 pm Thursday. Adding 10 hours gives 12 am Friday, and 7 more hours gives 7 am Friday.

The time in Auckland is 7 am, Friday, option D.

parts.latex:
Diego flew from Sydney to Hong Kong. Diego departed Sydney at 10:15 pm Coordinated Universal Time (UTC +10) on Wednesday and travelled via Singapore.

The flight from Sydney to Singapore took 7 hours 50 minutes.

The time between arriving in Singapore and departing from Singapore was 2 hours and 15 minutes.

The flight from Singapore to Hong Kong took 3 hours 40 minutes.

Singapore and Hong Kong both operate on UTC +8.

What time and day was it when Diego arrived in Hong Kong?

solutions.latex:
Hong Kong is UTC $+8$ and Sydney is UTC $+10$, so the time difference is
$$10 - 8 = 2 \text{ hours}$$
Total travel time:
$$7\text{ h }50\text{ min} + 2\text{ h }15\text{ min} + 3\text{ h }40\text{ min} = 13\text{ h }45\text{ min}$$
$$\begin{aligned} \text{Arrival} &= 10{:}15\text{ pm} + 13\text{ h }45\text{ min} - 2\text{ h} \\ &= 10{:}15\text{ pm} + 11\text{ h }45\text{ min} \\ &= 10{:}00\text{ am Thursday} \end{aligned}$$
$$\therefore\ \text{Diego arrived at 10:00 am Thursday, Hong Kong local time}$$
criteria: Finds the travel time, or equivalent merit
Finds the time difference, or equivalent merit

parts.latex:
A football game is being played in Quito (UTC $-5$) starting at 3:40 pm on Tuesday.

What is the time in Sydney (UTC $+10$) when the game starts in Quito?

solutions.latex:
Convert the Quito time to UTC, then to Sydney time.

Quito is UTC $-5$, so UTC is 5 hours ahead of Quito:
$$3{:}40\text{ pm} + 5 \text{ h} = 8{:}40 \text{ pm Tuesday (UTC)}$$
Sydney is UTC $+10$, so add 10 hours:
$$8{:}40\text{ pm} + 10 \text{ h} = 6{:}40 \text{ am Wednesday}$$
The difference between the two places is 15 hours.

Hence the correct option is D.

meta.self_check: Time difference 15 h added to 3:40 pm Tuesday.

parts.latex: If it is 2:30 pm on Tuesday in Montreal (UTC $-$ 4), what time and day is it in Perth (UTC $+$ 8)?

solutions.latex:
Perth is ahead of Montreal by
$$8 + 4 = 12 \text{ hours}$$
Adding 12 hours to 2:30 pm Tuesday:
$$\therefore\ \text{2:30 am Wednesday}$$
criteria: Finds the time difference of 12 hours, or equivalent merit

parts.latex:
Maximilian is in Athens, which is two hours ahead of the Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). Dominic is in New York, which is five hours behind UTC.

Dominic is going to fly from New York to Athens. His flight will leave on Wednesday at 9am, New York time, and will take 11 hours.

What day and time will it be in Athens when he arrives?

solutions.latex:
Athens is 2 hours ahead of UTC and New York is 5 hours behind UTC, so the time difference is
$$2 - (-5) = 7 \text{ hours}$$
Arrival in New York time: $9\text{ am} + 11\text{ h} = 8\text{ pm}$ Wednesday.

Add the time difference to get Athens time.

$\therefore$ Dominic arrives in Athens at $3$ am Thursday.
criteria: Finds the time difference and the New York arrival time, or equivalent merit
Finds the time difference, or equivalent merit
